children.name: desktop-chromium
foundation.spec.js
Opening allroutes.app
the dev build is served and the page identifies itself as allroutes.app
before any import, the activity counter shows zero
ftu-tour-walkthrough.spec.js
Welcome tour walkthrough
the welcome tour auto-opens, advances and recedes through all six cards, then closes on finish
a second visit does not reopen the welcome tour
clicking the splash fades it out and removes it from the page
import-garmin-match-window.spec.js
Match Garmin FIT files to their JSON metadata
a FIT at the +2 second edge takes the JSON metrics
a FIT one second past the window falls back to FIT-computed metrics
import-garmin.spec.js
Import a Garmin Connect export
links FIT activities to JSON metadata and skips stubs
import-gps-zip.spec.js
Import a bare ZIP of loose GPS files
renders every GPS file including gzipped entries
import-kmz.spec.js
Import a KMZ file
renders the inner KML track
import-loose.spec.js
Import loose GPS files
renders a mixed multi-file drop of gpx, tcx, kml and fit
import-strava.spec.js
Import a Strava export ZIP
renders every activity that has a GPS file in the ZIP
journey-finder.spec.js
Journey finder
the Find rail button opens the finder and lists every journey
searching filters the list by name and type
clicking a journey opens its popup on the map
malformed-inputs.spec.js
Malformed and empty inputs
a corrupt ZIP (no End-of-Central-Directory) is rejected without rendering
a valid but empty ZIP (no activities.csv, no GPS files) reports a clear error
a loose GPX with no coordinates reads successfully but renders nothing
post-render-date-filter.spec.js
Date range filter
a complete date window hides routes outside it and follows the metrics count and totals
an incomplete or reversed range does not filter
a window whose bounds fall on activity dates includes them
Date range filter combined with type toggles
a date window and a type toggle narrow the map together
post-render-instagram-story.spec.js
Exporting a 3D route as a story image
the Image button downloads a 1080x1920 PNG when native sharing is unavailable
the Image button shares the PNG when the device supports native sharing
post-render-milestones.spec.js
Milestones panel
lists all-time records by type and stays fixed when the map is filtered
clicking a record whose activity type is hidden re-enables that type
clicking a record hidden by the date filter clears the date filter
clicking a virtual-ride record re-enables the indoor sub-toggle
post-render-mutations.spec.js
Post-render map mutations
adding a loose GPS file appends to the map without replacing
re-adding a file already on the map is skipped, a new file is not
removing a selected route drops it and recomputes the rest
cancelling a removal leaves every route in place
clearing the map returns to the first-time state
post-render-peaks.spec.js
Conquered Peaks overlay
draws a summit pin only for routes above the altitude threshold
collapses nearby summits to one pin and keeps the highest
rebuilds with the peaks toggle and the active type filter
post-render-persist-view.spec.js
Lightweight view persistence
panning remembers the settled view without rewriting the session record
restoring reopens the map at the last settled view
forgetting the saved map also forgets the remembered view
post-render-platform-conflict.spec.js
Platform conflict at render
two Strava exports are rejected with a single-Strava message
two Garmin exports are rejected with a single-Garmin message
a Strava and a Garmin export cannot be combined
post-render-popup-links.spec.js
Route popup deep links per source
a Strava route links to strava.com
a Garmin route links to Garmin Connect
a Komoot route links to komoot.com
a Ride With GPS route links to ridewithgps.com
a source with no platform id shows no deep link
a route added after render links via the post-add popup
post-render-popup.spec.js
Route popup and GPX export
the route popup offers the 3D and GPX actions
GPX export downloads a valid GPX for the route
post-render-replay.spec.js
Replay the route animation
replaying the map redraws every route
picking a different pace records it as the active replay speed
replay is blocked in preview mode
post-render-session.spec.js
Session save and restore
saving the current map downloads a valid session file
a saved session restores routes and filter state after clearing
an invalid session file is rejected and the current map is untouched
post-render-share-3d.spec.js
Opening a shared 3D link
a valid v:2 3D link opens the 3D view for the shared route
a v:2 link with no coords shows an error and opens nothing
post-render-share-consume.spec.js
Opening a shared link
a valid ?share= link renders the shared map
a broken or expired link shows an error and draws nothing
an invalid ?share= id is ignored - no fetch, no shared-mode UI
post-render-share.spec.js
Share link
creating a share link opens the modal with a ready-to-copy link
a share service failure is handled without opening the modal
post-render-sidebar.spec.js
Sidebar rail navigation
the rail switches the visible sidebar panel and closes it again
post-render-toggles.spec.js
Type and heatmap toggles
toggling an activity type hides its routes and follows the metrics count
the heatmap toggle adds and removes the heat canvas
post-render-trip-share.spec.js
Share and view a trip
a shared trip carries only its own activities
a trip opens in the 3D view
a trip with no loaded activities cannot be shared
post-render-trips.spec.js
Trips group activities
a trip built from two activities lists with the right count and totals
editing a trip name persists
cancelling trip creation adds nothing
deleting a trip removes it and clears the grouping
selecting a trip scopes the metrics, deselecting restores them
post-render-wrapped-controls.spec.js
Wrapped period and type controls
opening Wrapped lands in Year mode with the year picker showing
the type picker lists every activity type present, All types first
switching period swaps the picker and rebuilds the cards
filtering by type in Year mode names the saved file for that type
all-time by type names the saved file for all time and the type
post-render-wrapped-figures.spec.js
Wrapped figures match the activities
the year totals match that year's activities
the per-type breakdown matches
the crown route, biggest climb and dominant type are the right activities
the comparison lines and elevation milestones match the totals
countries counts the distinct countries visited
all-time mode aggregates across every year
filtering by type narrows the figures
post-render-wrapped-mechanics.spec.js
Wrapped opens and builds
opening Wrapped builds a full set of cards and enables sharing
the year picker lists every year with activities, newest first
the empty-selection state shows when a period has no activities
the arrows move through the cards and stop at both ends
post-render-wrapped-selection.spec.js
Wrapped selection edges and filenames
changing the year rebuilds and re-bases the saved filename
all-time with no type filter saves under the all-time base
a period with no matching activities shows the empty state
post-render-wrapped-share.spec.js
Wrapped card sharing
sharing the current card downloads a 1080x1920 PNG when native sharing is unavailable
sharing the current card uses the native share sheet when available
sharing follows the selected card
sharing all cards downloads every card when native sharing is unavailable
sharing all cards hands the whole set to the native share sheet when available
reference-routes-draw.spec.js
Add reference routes to the map
a reference route draws in dashed slate without touching the stats
reference routes of every loose format draw together
a reference already on the map is not added twice
reference-routes-popup-3d.spec.js
Reference route popup and 3D
the reference popup shows the reference tag and no personal actions
opening a reference in 3D disables the 3D share button
the 3D share exclusion is specific to reference routes
reference-routes-toggle.spec.js
Toggle and clear reference routes
adding a reference reveals its own toggle, checked and on
the reference toggle hides only references; a type toggle hides only personal
clearing the map wipes reference routes and their toggle
reimport-resets-state.spec.js
Reimport resets state
loading your own export replaces the Try Now sample instead of adding to it
the sample preview chrome clears once your own data is mapped
share-roundtrip.spec.js
Shared map round-trip
the same payload survives serialise, compress, and reload
only visible routes are shared
smoke.spec.js
First visit critical journey
the app boots to the welcome splash with the activity counter at zero
dismissing the splash brings up the welcome tour, and skipping it reveals the app
Try Now renders the bundled sample of 25 adventures on the map
the whole journey completes without a single page error
stats-metrics-values.spec.js
Headline metrics match the activities
all-time totals reflect every activity
the date filter recomputes distance and elevation, not only the count
